text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both suffered defeat... Mejiro Palmer 
offers words of encouragement, but Mejiro 
McQueen can't hold back her tears of 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching that, Mejiro Palmer wondered. Did 
she really possess feelings this 
passionate?
